product.title: Mount Vernon Day Trip

description.text: Day-trip to George Washington's Mount Vernon estate on a five-hour tour from Washington, D.C. with guided visits to the mansion, museum, and Potomac River grounds. Your guide covers Washington's life at the estate before allowing free time in the gardens and farm areas. Motorcoach transport handles the Virginia drive while admission is included. This half-day outing suits travelers who want founding-era history without a full-day Arlington combination.
